name: Petalburg City
lines:
Hee hee hee...
This is the Accuracy Room.
It’s pretty nasty when every attack
lands without fail.

There are even more fearsome
Trainers waiting for you ahead.
The Defense Room is on the left.
The Recovery Room is to the right.
Whichever way you go, your Pokémon’s
Attack power will be on trial.

Do you know what we are
trying to achieve as Trainers?
We’re striving to be completely
in sync with our Pokémon.
